headline: Reserve Bank of India overnight VRR auction attracts strong bids
summary: The Reserve Bank of India received nearly double the requested bids for its overnight variable rate repo auction, indicating robust liquidity demand.
why: Central bank liquidity operations help manage short-term interest rates and banking system cash flows, directly influencing borrowing costs in emerging markets.

impacts.name: India
